claims.claim_summary: Unused details recede naturally without explicit importance scores or decay rules.

evidence_spans.source_text: Meanwhile, an ordinary remotecontrol episode is first retained with its destination, then reduced to an item in a list of completed tasks, after which its episode-specific details no longer occur in the narrative.
